numeric_conventions.shortest_paths: SciPy Dijkstra in float64. Some checks use Floyd-Warshall or SciPy's automatic selection.
numeric_conventions.persistence: Ripser.py over F2 with float32 endpoints. Retain every returned interval with death > birth.
numeric_conventions.arc_support_tolerance: 0 for peanut closure and 1e-10 in the locality check
numeric_conventions.clean_circle_count_tolerance: positive returned intervals, no lifetime cutoff

rank_table.pairing: one uniform point set and phase shared across profiles; both graph rules share each sample

uniform_rank_comparison.generator: std::mt19937_64, open-interval uniforms converted to exponential spacings

events: smallest connecting k for both kNN rules

radial_noise.displacement: delta times the draw in the outward unit normal direction
radial_noise.pairing: same clean cloud and noise draws across amplitudes, and the same observed cloud for both rules at each amplitude

peanut_detection.search: all connected prefixes in increasing order until the first nonempty H1 diagram
peanut_detection.pairing: same seed and arc coordinates for all five shapes

radius_enlargement.curve_results: Independent cohorts for each curve and size. The three factors reuse each cohort. Table 3 uses consecutive-chord proxies, with full-diagram checks in separate records.
